original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the exact BMC WebUI can export and save the complete System Event Log as a usable artifact, with independent read-only SEL evidence sufficient to assess completeness.
original_method: An authorized operator performs the exact Event Log Export all/Save workflow and confirms the downloaded file; automation securely collects a complete read-only SEL mirror, hashes/parses both artifacts and reconciles record scope without modifying logs.
manual_activity: An authorized operator must perform and confirm the exact WebUI download, including final file presence; automation can collect/reconcile the complete CLI mirror but cannot infer the browser artifact exists.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/SUT identity, WebUI version/path and authenticated operator
Expected export file format, headers, encoding, timestamp/timezone and full SEL scope
Secure evidence directory, deterministic filename, retention and redaction policy
Protected BMC credentials and complete read-only SEL retrieval method
Web export to raw SEL record-ID/event mapping and allowed presentation differences
Policy for empty SEL, concurrent new events and snapshot timing
safety_requirements: Never clear, delete, acknowledge or alter SEL/BMC settings
Do not expose credentials, session tokens or sensitive event payloads
Preserve original download and raw mirror; redact only derived copies
Stop on wrong BMC, truncated/unreadable file, authentication error or irreconcilable snapshot timing
No automatic repeat that could overwrite the original artifact or hide changing logs
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and evidence policy before UI action
Collect secure complete raw SEL mirror with record identities and timestamps
Hash/parse the operator-confirmed export and reconcile its owner-approved scope
Record concurrent-event boundary and all unmatched records
Make no Web click claim, log mutation, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve export schema/scope and record mapping rules
Provide/confirm WebUI operator download and raw file custody
Review missing/extra/malformed/mismatch evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool sel list` is a useful mirror, but command-line secrets and `tail -n 200` are unsafe/incomplete; CLI output cannot prove the WebUI export button produced a file.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected credentials to collect the complete read-only SEL with stable record IDs (and raw/elist form when approved), then parse and reconcile against the separately operator-confirmed Web export file.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Logs/Event Log navigation, both export/save actions, successful export criterion and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HYBRID WEBUI ARTIFACT PLUS COMPLETE SEL RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Freeze a comparison window, hash the downloaded raw file immediately, collect a complete record-ID-based SEL mirror, normalize timestamps/fields under the approved mapping and report missing/extra/changed records without altering either source.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces tail-limited/insecure mirror and assumed download success with two independently verified artifacts and traceable reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A partial CLI list can miss older records, while a UI success message cannot prove the file is complete, readable or from the right BMC. Both artifact integrity and content scope are necessary.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Events can arrive between UI export and CLI collection. Snapshot timestamps/record IDs must distinguish concurrency from export loss rather than requiring blind byte equality.

project_override_considerations: A project-specific CSV column order or localized text may be normalized only through a versioned WebUI schema; it cannot waive complete record scope or raw-file retention.
expected_evidence: Verified BMC/SUT/WebUI identity, operator and export timestamps
Original downloaded file name/size/hash/encoding/headers/record count and raw custody
Complete secure raw/decoded SEL mirror with record IDs and timestamps
Normalized export-to-SEL reconciliation including concurrent-event boundary and discrepancies
No clear/delete/acknowledge/settings change, secure-access/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require a WebUI SEL export. DeepSeek's partial mirror is incomplete but does not redefine the required artifact.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authorized WebUI download and evidence schema are normal package/user inputs. The agent cannot perform/attest the browser action alone, so the case is hybrid rather than globally blocked.

review_improvement: Preserves the required WebUI workflow and adds file-integrity plus complete record-level reconciliation without treating a truncated CLI mirror as success.
independent_technical_reasoning: Export success has two independent properties: the browser must actually produce a readable file, and that file must contain the intended SEL snapshot. A CLI mirror establishes neither property by itself, while a downloaded CSV alone can be truncated or from the wrong BMC. Stable record IDs and bounded timestamps are needed because new events can arrive between captures; using `tail -n 200` destroys the denominator and can falsely pass a large log.
